verdict.rationale: Licensing terms are a fair question for any self-hostable AI runtime, but the evidence pack never states LocalAI's license, whether commercial or enterprise use is free, or whether any paid edition or subscription exists. The phrase "one open runtime" is marketing language, not a documented licensing statement. The other items cover API compatibility, MCP, authentication and distributed mode, none of which address licensing.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
